title: A MettleUp Plus payment that was waiting does not open Plus when Google Play confirms it, until the app is closed and opened again
what: When Google Play answers that a payment is waiting (for example a UPI payment not yet approved), the member reads that Plus opens when Google Play confirms it. When Play later confirms it while the app is still open, the phone takes note of the payment with Google but never tells the app, and the app only asks Google Play again when it is started fresh. So the member has paid and the paid features stay locked until they close the app or tap I already paid.
expected: When Google Play confirms a waiting payment, Plus opens at once (or at least the next time the app comes back to the screen), as the message promised.
who: members who buy MettleUp Plus with a payment Google Play holds as waiting
how_often: not yet (starts the day payments go live); then every waiting payment
fix_line: When Google Play reports a confirmed purchase with no screen waiting, pass it to the app, and ask Google Play again whenever the app comes back to the front

title: MettleUp Plus purchases are kept only on the member's phone, so MettleUp never sees who paid, how much, or a refund
what: A MettleUp Plus purchase through Google Play is noted only in the phone's own storage. No server checks the purchase with Google and nothing is saved where HQ can see it. The phone code itself says server checking comes later, with payments live. So once buying opens, HQ has no list of buyers, no amounts to match against Google Play's payout, no way to see a refund, and a changed copy of the app could open Plus without paying.
expected: Before payments go live, each Plus purchase is checked with Google by the server and kept there, so HQ can see buyers, amounts and refunds and the phone cannot simply claim it paid.
who: MettleUp HQ and the owner, once member payments go live
how_often: not yet (starts the day payments go live); then every purchase
fix_line: Add a server check of each Google Play purchase before the payments-live switch is turned on, and show buyers and refunds in HQ

title: The refunds page says members never pay MettleUp, but the app is ready to sell MettleUp Plus to members, with no refund rule for it
what: The public refunds and cancellation page says members of a gym never pay MettleUp and the member app is free. The member app already holds a paid MettleUp Plus with monthly, yearly and for-life prices bought through Google Play. It is switched off today, so nothing is wrong yet, but the day it is switched on the refunds page becomes untrue and says nothing on how a member cancels or gets money back.
expected: A note on the payments-live switch that the refunds page must change the same day, adding how members cancel and get refunds for MettleUp Plus (through Google Play).
who: members who buy MettleUp Plus, once it is switched on
how_often: not yet (starts the day MettleUp Plus is switched on)
fix_line: Write the member Plus refund and cancel rule into the refunds page, ready for the switch day

title: A member who bought the yearly plan is told they pay every month after moving to a new phone
what: Google Play does not tell the app which plan a subscription is on. When a member taps I already paid on a new phone, or reinstalls, the app guesses monthly, and the top of the Plus screen and Settings then say they pay every month even when they pay yearly.
expected: The line says what the member really pays, or just says they have MettleUp Plus without naming monthly or yearly when it is not known.
who: yearly buyers on a new or reset phone
how_often: not yet (starts the day payments go live)
fix_line: When the plan is not known, show a line without monthly or yearly

items.reason: Plus screen shows three prices from one constant (149, 999, 2,499 rupees) or Google Play's own, and the pay note names Google Play; no GST words needed (Play charges). Purchases never reach a server (FN-L5-phone-screens-2-02); the refunds page breaks promise P-A7-legal-2-73 once Plus is on (FN-L5-phone-screens-2-03). Help box AI answers are paid from the gym's credits and given back when the AI fails. Shop routes here only re-export the shop folder's screens; plan, programs and report screens hold no money.

Plus: real Google Play buying only when the payments-live switch is on (it is off); QA builds use a stand-in store that says on screen no money is taken; the QA plan link does nothing outside QA builds; store builds cannot open the Plus page while the plan is off. No fault here. Test-mode shop and dues payments belong to the shop folder (FN-L5-server-panel-worker-01, not repeated).

Plus: cancelled, failed, waiting, unavailable and not-live each get their own words; a refunded or ended purchase is dropped when the app next asks Google Play at start; a waiting payment confirmed later stays locked until restart (FN-L5-phone-screens-2-01). Ask a trainer hides when the gym plan ended. Shop order states on the shop screens these routes open reuse FN-L5-phone-shop-1-02 and FN-L5-phone-shop-1-03.

Plus prices come from one constant used by the buttons; the help article sends readers to the Plus screen rather than repeating numbers; no other page quotes Plus prices. Plus money never reaches panel or HQ, so nothing can be matched (FN-L5-phone-screens-2-02); a restored yearly plan is named monthly (FN-L5-phone-screens-2-04).
